description.content:
Lists all charge sessions completed by a fleet's managed vehicles on the Chargefox network. You can specify
      a date range to filter results. Both date parameters can be used together to define a period, or individually to filter usage records from or until a specific date. The returned list is a paginated set of 100 results per page.

query.description: Filters the results to include only those usage records that were completed on or after the specified date. This parameter sets the start date for the filter.
Filters the results to include only those usage records that were completed on or before the specified date. This parameter sets the end date for the filter.

Specifies the page number of the results to retrieve. The page parameter is used to request a specific page of the results, starting from `1` (the first page). If not provided, the default is to return the first page of results.

response.name: success
